cards.d: Tom Sawyer tricked Huckleyberry Finn to whitewash a house after receiving nine dead cats hung on a tree.
Burning is placing wood, coal and all sorts of things to fire.
The V.I.P. area, located in the ceiling of the house, is reserved to but a few people; those who have enough shells.
cards.e: 國賓 국빈 state guest; 貴賓 귀빈 an honored/important guest

cards.d: Time does not stop its march but a little for the New Year holidays.
cards.e: 歲拜 세배 New Year's bow; 歲月 세월 time, times, conditions

cards.d:
The all-seeing eye 目 of the prefecture has got all the little 小 people down below hooked 乚 into obeying the laws.
The modern character for prefecture traces its lineage back to this the old one 県.
A lonely oak tree standing on a cliff bring ten thousand acorns every year in hope to grow up a company for itself.
